name: Cheer Kanojo
source:
It was summer.
The main character is a football player who aims to participate in the national tournament.
He had a girlfriend who supported him from the stand.
She was always there to do some cheerleading and watch him.
But he could not understand what was going on...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE053787.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
那是一个夏天。
主人公是一名足球运动员，以参加全国大赛为目标。
他有一位总在看台上支持自己的女朋友。
她一直在那里，为他加油，也注视着他。
然而，他无法理解正在发生的一切……
